messages:
noah: Morning all, first-day laptop question. M1 Max, macOS 13.6, Kandji enrolled. Trying to install Docker Desktop but macOS blocks a kernel extension and asks for a system extension approval in Security & Privacy. Anyone run into this during onboarding?
onboard-bot: Welcome @noah! :wave: IT usually helps with kext/system extension approvals. Pinging them.
it-support: Hey Noah 44b can you paste the exact message macOS shows (screenshot text OK) and confirm if System Integrity Protection (SIP) is enabled? Also did you install via the official Docker DMG or Homebrew?
noah: It says "System Extension Blocked: A program tried to load new system extensions signed by Docker Inc." with a button to "Allow" in Security & Privacy. Installed from the official DMG. SIP should be enabled by default; I haven't changed it.
marta: For Apple Silicon, most modern Docker installs use a privileged helper rather than kexts, but some versions still prompt. We avoid asking people to disable SIP. IT can either (1) push a Kandji payload to pre-approve the extension, or (2) grant a short temp-admin so you can open Security & Privacy and click "Allow" after the install attempts. Which do you prefer?
noah: Prefer not to mess with SIP. Happy to wait for a Kandji push. How long does that take?
it-support: Kandji policy typically checks in within 5-10 minutes. I'll target your serial. Also, after you click Allow, a reboot may be required. If the Allow button is grayed out, it often means you need to unlock the pane (click the padlock and authenticate).
people-ops: Welcome again @noah! If this blocks SSO or VPN onboarding steps, let us know and we can expedite IT.
noah: Thanks everyone. I'll sit tight for the Kandji push. One more thing  will the pre-approval show up in System Preferences or just silently allow the extension?
it-support: It should install the extension and mark it trusted; you'll see Docker services start and the Security & Privacy prompt should not appear on subsequent attempts. If anything still blocks, reply here and we'll do a temp-admin session.
noah: Saw the Kandji notification, installed, rebooted, Docker launched fine. No prompt. All set 603 Thanks!
it-support: Closing loop 44d welcome aboard and ping #help if other tools act up.
